title: Make calendar and inquiry PostgreSQL suites collect together
requirements: Rename or otherwise uniquely identify the CAL-001 PostgreSQL test module so pytest can collect it in one invocation with tests/admin_inquiries/test_postgres_integration.py. Preserve every existing calendar test assertion and its isolated synthetic database fixture.

Prove the repair by running pytest over both admin_inquiries and admin_visits directories in one invocation. Do not alter application code, inquiry tests, database migrations, configuration, test data semantics or external integrations.
acceptance: The combined owner inquiry and calendar PostgreSQL test invocation collects both files and passes without an import-file mismatch.
Focused combined tests and whitespace checks pass with only the calendar test path and task-spec changes.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Lead regression detected a duplicate pytest module basename; this narrowly repairs test collection without changing product behavior.
